sourceTitle: 2024 General Election Early Voting After Action Report
acquisitionMethod: Structured extract from the official PDF text after direct download was blocked by the county site's anti-bot challenge

facts.response: Tucson Police Bomb Squad and a K-9 unit checked the location and deemed it safe.
facts.operationalImpact: Staff were allowed to leave if concerned, but none did; the report does not describe a voting-site closure.

caveat: The official PDF was verified and its relevant passage was accessible, but direct scripted acquisition encountered an anti-bot challenge. This structured extract records only the fields used by the registry and points to the canonical official PDF.
